reasoning: Both attempts spread loading and unloading across frames, drop the two child instances per block, set properties before parenting, and keep the removal rules. A reserves every saved cell before the first block is created and cleans up correctly when a player leaves mid-load. B leaves cells open while they load, so other blocks can claim a saved block's cell, which criterion 4 is written to catch.

criteria.note: The StringValue and NumberValue are replaced by the `OwnerId` and `PlacedAt` attributes plus the server-side `plotsByBlock` table. Saved and new blocks both keep their placed time through `createBlock(plot, ..., placedAt)`.
`createBlock` builds the part with `Instance.new("Part")`, sets its properties and attributes, then sets `part.Parent = plot.Folder` last.
`onHeartbeat` works through `busyPlots` under the 3 ms `FRAME_ALLOWANCE`, checking `os.clock()` every 8 blocks. Unloading goes through the same `stepPlot` loop via `Removals`.

criteria.criterion: No overlaps or half states during load
criteria.note: `startLoading` writes every cell to `occupied` and `PendingCells` before any block is created. `startUnloading` frees the pending cells that were never built and queues the built blocks for destruction. The state check after `SavedBuilds.load` handles a player leaving while the load yields.
`onRemoveBlock` requires `plot.Owner == player`, refuses plots in the `Unloading` state, and still calls `getReachableRoot`. All of the placement validation is unchanged.
Says builds appear over about 2 s, labels its table as "Expected numbers (not yet measured)" and lists what players will notice. The "Measured on a baseplate ... 1.6x" claim is a little loose.
Changes stay in `Builds.server.luau` and the doc. The `Plot` and `PlotState` types are clear, and luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass.
Owner and placed time move to the server-side tables `blockOwners` and `blockPlacedAt`, keyed by part, and are set for both saved and newly placed blocks.
Clones a per-type template, sets its CFrame, then parents it.
`runJobs` on Heartbeat is capped by both the 2 ms `FRAME_BUDGET` and `MAX_BLOCKS_PER_FRAME` = 250. Unload jobs use the same budgets and go to the front of the queue.

criteria.criterion: No overlaps or half states during load
criteria.note: `stepLoad` checks `occupied` one block at a time, so cells are not reserved before loading starts. Anyone can place into a cell that is still loading, and the doc admits the saved block is then skipped. Cleanup when a player leaves mid-load is correct.
Keeps the `IsDescendantOf` check, uses `blockOwners[block] ~= player.UserId` as the owner check, and still checks reach.
Says builds appear over about 1.5 s and states plainly that nothing was verified in Studio. That figure assumes 250 blocks per frame, and the 2 ms budget may be the real limit.
Clean and typed, and all checks pass. `onPlayerAdded` polls with `task.wait`, and `plotSlots` is typed as `Player | boolean`, which is slightly awkward.

strengths: Reserves every cell up front, so no overlaps during a load
Cleans up correctly when a player leaves mid-load or during the yield in `SavedBuilds.load`
Shared time budget, plus an event-driven queue for players waiting on a slot
weaknesses: Attributes still add a little replication data per block
Some doc figures rest on baseplate numbers that were not measured in this place

strengths: Two caps per frame: time and block count
Honest about what was not verified
weaknesses: Cells are not reserved before the load starts, so blocks can overlap a loading save
Waits for a free slot by polling
The duration estimate ignores the time budget
